items.topic: Member logs a reimbursement without accounting words
items.angle: Paid for the hall yourself? Tap 'I paid for something'
items.layout: headline + two tilted phones + Dot top-right
items.caption:
Paid for the hall yourself? 🙋
You don't need to know what "debit" means. In Vault you just tap "I paid for something for the club", add the amount and a photo of the receipt. Done.
The treasurer approves, and the club pays you back. No chasing, no lost slips.

items.topic: Events: RSVP, QR check-in, service hours
items.caption:
RSVP. Scan. Hours logged. ✅
No more paper sign-in sheets that go missing after the project. Members RSVP in the app, scan a QR code at the venue, and their service hours count automatically.
Dot handles the scanning 📲

items.topic: Dot's Tip #1: never mix club money and project money
items.hook: Dot's Tip #1 💡 Never mix club money and project money.
items.caption:
Dot's Tip #1 💡 Never mix club money and project money.
Money raised for a project gets spent on that project. Dues run the club. Keep each one in its own drawer, and if one ever pays for the other, write down that it's owed back.
Vault keeps the drawers separate for you.
📌 Save it · 📤 Share it with your board
items.notes: FRESHNESS WARNING: repeats carousel L04 slide 3 one week later. Consider replacing with a fresh tip (e.g. 'keep every receipt, even small ones') and moving this to week 7+.
